semiconductor_relevance: High — Lijihong Optoelectronic Technology specializes in wet process equipment for the semiconductor and optoelectronics industries.
summary: Lijihong Optoelectronic Technology provides a range of wet process equipment, including tank etching and cleaning systems, as well as single wafer processing solutions. The company aims to support the semiconductor industry with integrated services from design to after-sales support.
capabilities: WET BENCH tank etching and cleaning equipment
SINGLE WAFER single crystal wafer etching and cleaning equipment

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Nantong, with a sister company in Shanghai that provides trade and technical consulting services.
